column1: Zod: strict integer parse of a whole-token string (reject '123abc', '12.9')?
column2:

column1: tsx watch (and nodemon / node --watch): reload or HMR?
column2:
Full PROCESS RESTART on every file change — NOT hot module replacement.
Kills Node, relaunches fresh -> every startup side-effect re-runs (DB pool, bot init,
command registration). Browser HMR swaps modules in-place and keeps state; backend
tooling restarts because hot-swapping live sockets mid-flight is fragile.

column1: Does a green `tsc` / check-types mean no dead code?
column2:
No. TypeScript flags unused LOCALS (noUnusedLocals) but never unused EXPORTS —
an exported symbol is assumed used by some other module. So an orphaned exported
function (e.g. after an extract-and-replace refactor) type-checks clean.
Catch dead exports with grep, or knip / ts-prune / eslint no-unused-exports.
